originals.why: Moved row is fine. 'achos iddi droi i'r chwith' is natural North Welsh for 'because she turned left', and troi i'r chwith keeps the sense this course teaches.

originals.ko: 너는 저기에서 왼쪽으로 돌지 않는 게 좋겠어
맞아, 나는 지금 왼쪽으로 돌고 싶어
왜 그녀는 왼쪽으로 돌 수 없을까?
그녀가 왼쪽으로 돌았기 때문이라고 너 생각해?
originals.why: Moved row is fine. Ending on the tag 'wyt ti'n meddwl?' is natural spoken Welsh, and troi i'r chwith keeps the taught sense.

originals.ko: 나는 아무도 못 봤어, 왜냐하면 그녀가 왼쪽으로 돌았으니까
originals.why: Moved row is fine. 'weles i neb achos iddi droi i'r chwith' is natural and idiomatic, and troi i'r chwith keeps the taught sense.
